source: VAR(1), OLS per equation, 1992-2025 (n = 34); data: World Bank API, CHE: FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG and SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS (ILO estimate), CC BY 4.0

labour_sources.duration_months: average unemployment duration ~7 months (swissinfo.ch citing SECO data); job-finding chance = 1/duration per month
labour_sources.registered_share: SECO registered rate 2025 = 2.8% (kmu.admin.ch, 'Unemployment up 20% in one year') / ILO rate 2025 = 4.873% (World Bank): turns the forecast ILO rate into the registered rate that matches the SECO duration
labour_sources.replacement: Swiss unemployment insurance (AVIG Art. 22): 70% of insured earnings; employees only (the self-employed cannot insure)
labour_sources.replacement_higher: 80% with maintenance obligations to children, or insured salary <= CHF 3,797/month (AVIG Art. 22)
labour_sources.low_salary_threshold_month: AVIG Art. 22: below this insured salary the rate is 80%
labour_sources.max_months_standard: 400 daily allowances with >= 18 months of contributions (AVIG Art. 27; ~21.7 allowances per month)
labour_sources.max_months_young: 200 daily allowances: under 25 without maintenance obligations (AVIG Art. 27)
labour_sources.max_months_55plus: 520 daily allowances: age >= 55 with >= 22 months of contributions (AVIG Art. 27)
labour_sources.real_wage_growth: assumption: pay follows LAST year's inflation (Swiss wage rounds), no real growth
